items.name: Richmond Open A 2021
items.information:
As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), All attendees are required to have **FULL vaccination (2 doses)** by the event date otherwise, you will NOT be allowed to enter the venue.

Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to.

Note that this is a **one of a pair of series competitions**. Series competitions (formerly known as twin competitions) are relatively new to BC. Please see the Series Competiton Tab for more information.

Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab, containing our Risk Mitigation Plan.

Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free.  Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers as low as possible. **If you're not a competitor, nor the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.**

Note: As the pandemic is an ever-evolving situation, there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions or, in the worst case, cancel the competition. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. In the eventof cancellation we will do our best to provide full refunds to everyone.

items.name: Tokai Winter PM 2021

venue.name: [刈谷市産業振興センター (Kariya Industrial Promotion Center)](https://www.city.kariya.lg.jp/shisetsu/sangyo_keizai/1005633.html)
venue.address: 〒448-0027 刈谷市相生町1丁目1番地6(1-1-6, Aioicho, Kariya, Aichi)

items.information:
**東海冬AM2021 (以下、AM大会) と東海冬PM2021 (以下、PM大会) は 、WCA Competition Requirements Policy で定められているところの「Series Competitions」となります。**
このため、いずれかの大会の申込みのみが承認されます。
両方に申込んだ場合は、申込日時が早い方を受理し、申込日時が遅い方は無効とします。悪しからずご了承ください。

なお、AM大会とPM大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。

* AM大会は、3x3x3 キューブと 2x2x2 キューブの2種目です。
* PM大会は、3x3x3 キューブの1種目のみです。

COVID-19対策のため、入場者数を制限します。**事前承認のない見学はお断りします。**見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛にメールを送ってください。
_____
**Tokai Winter AM 2021 (AM) and Tokai Winter PM 2021 (PM) are "Series Competitions" defined in the WCA Competition Requirements Policy.**
Therefore, you can register either of these competitions. If you register for both competitions, the earlier one will only be recieved, and the later one will be rejected. 

Please make sure that the events for AM and PM are different. 

* AM event holds the 3x3x3 cube and the 2x2x2 cube.    
* PM holds only one event, the 3x3x3 cube.   

The number of persons in the venue is controlled as COVID-19 countermeasure. If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, **please be sure to email the organization team in advance.** or we will not permit your entrance.!

items.information:
### ¡Volvemos a los torneos oficiales después de 2 años!
Estamos muy emocionados por volver a reencontrarnos y retomar las competencias. Te esperamos para descubrir quien es el nuevo Campeón Nacional de Speedcubing en nuestro país
Asegurate de leer **todo el reglamento**, inscribirte adecuadamente y estar al tanto de todos los protocolos sanitarios que estaremos implementados para cuidarnos entre todos y divertirnos al máximo
Cualquier consulta que tengas no dudes en contactarte con los organizadores del evento

**CLUB DE SPEEDCUBING PARAGUAY**
Email: [cubosrpy@gmail.com](https://mailto:cubosrpy@gmail.com)
Facebook: https://web.facebook.com/cscpy/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cscpy/

### We return to official tournaments after 2 years!
We are very excited to meet again and resume racing. We are waiting for you to discover who is the new National Speedcubing Champion in our country
Make sure you read all the regulations, register properly and be aware of all the health protocols that we will be implementing to take care of each other and have the most fun
Any questions you have, do not hesitate to contact the event organizers

items.name: Basauri Open 2021
items.information:
El uso de la mascarilla será obligatorio en todo el edificio durante toda la duración del evento. Habrá gel hidroalcohólico a disposición de todos los participantes en todas las mesas de competición, tanto como en la entrada y salida del edificio. Los asientos serán nominativos, por lo tanto, cada competidor permanecerá sentado en ellas si no está compitiendo. El resto de asientos se podrán ocupar hasta completar aforo.

Wearing a mask is compulsory during all the competition. There will be hand sanitizer available for the use of the competitors at the competition tables, such as at the entrance and exit of the building. The seats will be nominative, so while not competing, the competitors must remain seated at their designated place. The rest of the seats may be taken up to the maximum capacity of the venue

Musukoa erabiltzea derrigorrezkoa da, eraikin osoan eta txapelketa-iraupen guztian. Gel hidroalkoholikoa mahai guztietan, lehiakideek erabil dezaten egongo da, baita sarreran eta irteeran ere. Lehiakide bakoitzak eserleku bat edukiko du txapelketa guztirako, eta han geratu behar da, parte-hartzen ez duen bitartean. Aretoa bete arte sartu ahal izango dira nahi duten pertsonak.
